usedFor: Square holds orders and payments, and Freshsales Classic holds the deal that “Update Deal” changes after “Invoice Payment Made”.

bestTemplate.name: “Invoice Payment Made” in Square, then “Update Deal” in Freshsales Classic
bestTemplate.why: It can change a deal's amount, stage, probability or expected close date once an invoice is paid.

watchOut: “Update Deal” finds the deal by ID or name, so the Square event must carry one matching an existing deal.
